display.purpose: Page H1s and the final call to action, sentence case.

motion.name: ease-genra

breakpoints.name: side
breakpoints.value: min-width 1024px, or landscape with max-height 600px and min-width 640px

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b0b0b; color: #f5f4ef; padding: 16px 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 15px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #374151; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b0b0b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary action: ink label with a mint rule that extends on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #0b0b0b; font: 500 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link span { display: block; height: 1px; width: 32px; background: #34d399; transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link:hover span { width: 48px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, white field, 4px corners, ink border on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 10px; color: #374151; font: 500 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #0b0b0b; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 16px; font: 400 16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #374151; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0b0b0b; }

narrative.overview: GENRA's pages read like an engineer's annotated drawing: ivory paper, black ink, precise hairlines, numbered parts and a single mint mark where attention belongs. The one place the drawing comes alive is the homepage hero, the Molten Ring; everything around it is calm.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper, Obsidian ink, Silver hairlines, Mint as a mark, never a fill.
Sora 600 display in sentence case; Inter for reading.
Structure from numbered rows and 1px rules, not from boxes.
One signature motion (the ring); everywhere else motion only confirms.

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: Mint covers well under 5% of any screen and is never used for text.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Sections sit on Ivory or Mist; Mist comes in grouped zones, never alternating stripes. No dark bands.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case; eyebrows at most one per three sections.

rules.name: The Numbered Part Rule
rules.body: Ordered content carries two-digit tabular numbers.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Stand forward with a rule and space, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep sections on Ivory Paper (#f5f4ef), or Mist (#eeede9) in grouped zones, with Obsidian Ink text.
Do use mint only as a 1 to 2px rule, a dot, or the text-accent bar.
Do separate content with 1px Silver rules and numbered rows.
Do use credited, art-directed photography where an image carries meaning.
Do keep headings sentence case and at most two lines.
Do write copy with commas, colons, periods or parentheses; use an em dash only when nothing else works.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glassmorphism or glow.
Don't use mint for text, buttons or fills.
Don't introduce purple, blue or neon accents, robots, glowing brains or circuit imagery.
Don't put an eyebrow above every section heading.
Don't build card grids where a ruled list would do.
Don't invent clients, testimonials, metrics, logos or contact details.
Don't let images touch, merge or crossfade into one another.
